name: Can Tho
provinceNote: Vietnamese Wikipedia describes the city after the 2025 rearrangement as taking in the former Hậu Giang and Sóc Trăng provinces, about 6,360.83 km², with the administrative centre in phường Ninh Kiều. Decision 1519/QĐ-TTg of 2 December 2023, as the city legal-education portal reprints it, planned the pre-merger city at 1,440.40 km².
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A Mekong Delta city on the Hau River, best known for the Cai Rang floating market at dawn. Watch boats trade fruit and vegetables, walk the Ninh Kieu riverside at night, see the old Binh Thuy house, and eat hu tieu noodles and crispy pancakes. Stay one night so you can be on the river early.
getThere: 165 km or 155 km; 120 km of expressway
seoTitle: Can Tho: Cai Rang at dawn, Ninh Kieu after dark
seoDescription: Sleep in Ninh Kieu for the dawn boats at Cai Rang, then walk the quay after dark. The road from Ho Chi Minh City is about 165 km, 155 km between the centres, and 120 km of expressway.
intro: Wholesale boats crowd the river at Cái Răng while the light is still low, with fruit and vegetables hung on cây bẹo poles so a buyer can see the goods. Ninh Kiều is the quay you leave from, where the Hậu meets the Cần Thơ river, and the walk you come back to after dark.

Sleep in the centre if that dawn boat is the reason you came. A room there reaches Ninh Kiều, Chùa Ông, the Bình Thủy house, and Cái Răng. A same-morning ride from Ho Chi Minh City arrives after the wholesale boats have thinned.

After dark the quay is the evening. River restaurants there run 19:30–21:00 with đờn ca tài tử. A 2016 city account puts snack stalls on the quay from about 16:00 to 19:00 and tài tử on a yacht from 20:00 to 23:00. The night market on Hai Bà Trưng runs 17:00–22:00.

Breakfast on the market boats is hủ tiếu, bún riêu, and cà phê vợt. Later in town, look for nem nướng Cái Răng, the Can Tho crispy pancake, lẩu mắm, and canh chua. Đề Thám is the street for southern cooking.
gettingAround: Vietnam Tourism gives about 165 km from Ho Chi Minh City by motorbike or private car on the Mỹ Thuận–Cần Thơ expressway. The distance between the city centres is 155 km. Thanh Niên and Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp Việt Nam give a 120 km expressway, the length of that road, not a third centre-to-centre distance. Thanh Niên says the corridor takes about 2 hours instead of 3.5 hours and shortens the old road by 50 km. Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp Việt Nam says more than 2 hours instead of about 3.5 hours. Both give a maximum of 90 km/h and a minimum of 60 km/h. Two-way traffic opened on 30 December 2023. Temporary use began at 07:00 on 25 December 2023. Nhân Dân, on 15 October 2026, reported holds from 22:00 to 01:00 on 16–19 October 2026 for the Võ Văn Kiệt overpass. That window had ended by 22 October 2026.

Buy an express-bus ticket at bến xe Miền Đông in Ho Chi Minh City. Do not count on a public boat from Ho Chi Minh City. The four-day Mekong ride transfers from Tra Vinh to Can Tho in about three hours by car or bus. No passenger train ends in Can Tho. From Hanoi the approach is a train of 30 hours to Ho Chi Minh City, then a bus. A Ministry of Construction pre-feasibility study describes a future line of about 175.2 km, proposed for 2028–2035. A study is not a service.

Cần Thơ airport is also called Trà Nóc. The IATA code is VCA. The office is at 179B Lê Hồng Phong, phone 0292 3844 301. One address line puts that office in phường Thới An Đông. Another puts the same street number in Long Hoà, Bình Thủy. Hanoi–Can Tho is about 2 hours 10 minutes, and Da Nang–Can Tho about 1 hour 30 minutes. Those figures use the word about. They are not a timetable.

The base is Bến Ninh Kiều on Hai Bà Trưng. You can walk the quay at any hour. A listed visit is 120 minutes, and the quay phone is 02923820336. The listing’s clock runs the full day, from 12:00 SA to 11:59 CH, which is an open-quay form, not a closing time. The pedestrian street runs on weekends. Cái Răng is about 30 minutes by boat from the quay, 6 km by road, and also described as a few kilometers. The listing leaves the quay fee and the boat hire as đang cập nhật. Another account gives 300,000–700,000 VND a boat, depending on the number of guests.

stayAreas.name: Ninh Kiều riverside
stayAreas.summary: River rooms within walk of Bến Ninh Kiều, so the dawn boat is an early start rather than a drive from another town. Hotels and eating rooms cluster on that waterfront.

eat: Start with hủ tiếu passed boat to boat at Cái Răng, the Can Tho crispy pancake, and canh chua at dinner in town. Đề Thám is the eating street. The orchard tables at Mỹ Khánh come after the boats.
interestsBody: Dining is the dawn bowl on the boats, Đề Thám in town, and the garden plates at Mỹ Khánh.
Shopping is the old market hall and the night stalls on Hai Bà Trưng: clothes, handicrafts, fruit, and seafood. The dawn boats at Cái Răng are the wholesale market, not that shop street.
The floating market is Cái Răng at dawn, with produce on the cây bẹo poles.
Ninh Kiều after dark is the lit quay, the snack stalls, and đờn ca tài tử on the river.
The old house is the Dương house in Bình Thủy. Đình Bình Thủy is the communal hall beside that visit, not the same ticket.
The museum on Hòa Bình is the rainy-hour stop, with about 5,000 objects and English captions.
Phong Điền is the orchard hour after the boats: Mỹ Khánh, the noodle workshops, and Trúc Lâm Phương Nam. Bằng Lăng is a separate ride toward Thốt Nốt.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Hủ tiếu on the Cái Răng boats, bánh xèo, and canh chua in town.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: The night stalls on Hai Bà Trưng, and the old market hall on the same walk.
body: Chợ cổ, the old market hall, sits on the Ninh Kiều walk with Chùa Ông, on Hai Bà Trưng in phường Ninh Kiều. A first building went up around 1915. Come in the daytime and walk the hall.

After dark the night market on that street sells fruit, clothes, jewelry, handicrafts, and seafood along a paved lane. Stalls set up around 16:00 and trade from 17:00 to 22:00. The quay snack row, about 16:00 to 19:00, may be this crowd or the park stalls beside it. A line of 98 Phan Đình Phùng matches the tourism-centre block on other listings. It is not this market’s address.
Lotte Mart is at 84 Mậu Thân, with a cinema. Sense City, Big C, and Vinmart are the other large stores named in the city. The trip is still the hall and the night stalls.

cards.title: Ninh Kieu night market
cards.summary: Clothes, handicrafts, fruit, and seafood under the stalls on Hai Bà Trưng.

interestGroups.title: Floating market
interestGroups.summary: The wholesale boats are the reason to sleep here.
body: Sellers hang a sample on a long pole, the cây bẹo. Breakfast boats sell hủ tiếu, bún riêu, and coffee. The market’s trading culture was put on the national intangible-heritage list in 2016.

A second floating market sits at Phong Điền. Vietnam Airlines puts it about 17 km out by tỉnh lộ 923, best at 5:30–6:30, quieter than Cái Răng, with farmers selling from the garden onto the boats. The department and Vietnam Tourism do not give that market a clock or a fare. Do not borrow Cái Răng’s hours for it.

cards.title: Cai Rang floating market
cards.summary: Wholesale boats at dawn. The ride from Ninh Kiều is about 30 minutes.

cards.title: Phong Dien floating market
cards.summary: Farm boats at dawn about 17 km out, quieter than Cái Răng.

interestGroups.title: Ninh Kiều quay
interestGroups.summary: Sleep here, leave before dawn, and walk the river again after dark.
body: The quay is given as both phường Tân An, quận Ninh Kiều and phường Ninh Kiều, along Hai Bà Trưng. It sits on the right bank of the Hậu, in phường Tân An, in a park of 7,000 m². A bronze statue of Hồ Chí Minh is 7.2 m on a 3.6 m base, over 12 tons. From the quay you look toward Cầu Cần Thơ, finished in 2010, the cable-stayed bridge with the longest main span in Southeast Asia when it was finished, and toward the green islets of Xóm Chài and cồn Ấu. Cồn Sơn is a different islet.

Chùa Ông stands on this walk at 32 Hai Bà Trưng. It was finished in 1896 on 532 m², founded by Hoa people from Quảng Châu and Triệu Khánh. The hall is deep red, with incense coils, built at the end of the 19th century. It was listed as a national historic site in 1993. Entry is free, 07:00–18:00. Quan Thánh Đế’s day is lunar 24/6. The pedestrian street runs on weekends.

Chợ cổ sits on the same walk, on Hai Bà Trưng in phường Ninh Kiều, with a first building around 1915. The night market is that street, 17:00–22:00, with stalls setting up around 16:00. The quay snacks, about 16:00–19:00, are the park stalls and may be this crowd or a different row.

cards.title: Ninh Kiều quay
cards.summary: The Hậu, the boats, and the walk you come back to after Cái Răng.

cards.title: Ong Pagoda
cards.summary: The Cantonese hall of 1896 at 32 Hai Bà Trưng, free to enter.

interestGroups.title: Old house and communal house
interestGroups.summary: Bình Thủy’s Dương house, and the communal hall that does not share its ticket.
body: The Dương family built the house in 1870. It was named a national architectural and artistic monument in 2009. The department listing gives 08:00–16:00 and 20,000–50,000 VND. The national page gives no fee. The communal house does not share that gate.

Đình Bình Thủy is also called Long Tuyền Cổ Miếu. The Kỳ Yên Thượng Điền festival is held here each year and honors early settlers. The city’s list names Lễ Thượng Điền and Lễ Hạ Điền at Bến Ninh Kiều and does not treat them as the same rite.

cards.title: Binh Thuy ancient house
cards.summary: Five bays, cloth, lanterns, and teacups, at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa.

cards.title: Binh Thuy communal house
cards.summary: Long Tuyền Cổ Miếu, and the Kỳ Yên that honors early settlers.

interestGroups.title: City museum
interestGroups.summary: A standing collection on Hòa Bình when the river day needs a roof.
body: The museum was established in 1976, on 2,700 m², with about 5,000 objects: history of people in Can Tho, plant and fish specimens, and rice work of Kinh, Hoa, and Khmer people, with English captions. The museum site’s footer gives Số 1 đại lộ Hòa Bình, phường Ninh Kiều. Vietnam Tourism gives no. 1 Hoa Binh Avenue, Tan An, Ninh Kieu. A department listing gives Tuesday–Thursday 08:00–11:00 and 14:00–17:00, weekends and holidays 08:00–11:00 and 18:30–21:00, free entry, and a visit of 60 minutes. The museum page and the promotion centre also give free entry, while another department line leaves the fee as đang cập nhật. Monday and Friday are not on that schedule. The description is a standing collection, not a list of current exhibitions.

Munirangsyaram stands on the same avenue, at 36 Hòa Bình. Entry is free, and the hours are 08:00–18:00 every day. It began in 1948 in bamboo and leaf, with a 1954 gate in an Angkor-style triple tower, and a main hall continued in 1964 and inaugurated in 1988. Vietnam Airlines still says phường Tân An. It is not Chùa Ông.

cards.title: Can Tho Museum
cards.summary: About 5,000 objects on Hòa Bình, with English captions.

interestGroups.title: Phong Điền and the orchard road
interestGroups.summary: Fruit gardens after the market, then the long ride to the storks if you have the hours.
body: Plan the day as the floating market from 5:00, fruit gardens at midday, then the quay. Mỹ Khánh is about 10 km from the centre, at 335 Lộ Vòng Cung. A department tour text says more than 30 ha. A one-day article on the department site says more than 50,000 m². Newer lines say phường An Bình. Older lines say xã Mỹ Khánh, huyện Phong Điền. The garden offers dog racing, pig racing, a day as a landowner, draining a ditch for fish, boating, fishing, a craft visit, tài tử, and a monkey act. The operator’s gate is 149,000 VND for an adult over 1.3 m, 99,000 VND for a child from 1 m to under 1.3 m, and free under 1 m, open 07:30–17:00. The department listing says 07:00–18:00. The road from the centre is about twenty minutes.
A traditional noodle village in Can Tho offers a hủ tiếu pizza tasting after the sheets are made. A department tour text places a noodle workshop at Mỹ Khánh.

Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Phương Nam is a few hundred metres from Mỹ Khánh and about 15 km from the centre, on đường Mỹ Nhơn. It is nearly 4 ha on that account, the largest zen monastery in the delta there, with timber columns, tile roofs, and ship-tile floors. A construction value of 145 billion VND is also given. That figure is not a ticket.

Cồn Sơn, in the Hậu at Bình Thủy, is about 70 hectares. The boat from the Cổ Bắc ferry is about 5–10 minutes, and a boat can also be hired at Ninh Kiều. The kitchens there make bánh bò lụi, bánh ít, bánh bột lọc, bánh lá mít, bánh da lợn, bánh đúc, bánh xèo, and bánh khọt. It is not cồn Ấu.

Vườn cò Bằng Lăng is in Thốt Nốt. One account says 60 km from the centre, 20 stork species, 300,000 storks, and 16,500 m². The department advice page says about 50 km on National Route 91 and about 1.5 ha, formed in 1983. A 2020 article carried on the department site says Thới Bình 1, phường Thuận An, 60 km, a start at 13,097 m² and later 16,500 m², and also more than 15 ha and more than 300,000 birds. The birds leave around 5:00–6:00 and return at dusk. Breeding months are lunar August to lunar January for the flock, and lunar February–April for cò ma.

cards.title: Truc Lam Phuong Nam
cards.summary: Tiled halls and a garden court on the Mỹ Khánh road.

cards.title: My Khanh tourist village
cards.summary: Orchards, pig races, and a 115-year-old house on the Cần Thơ river.

cards.title: Con Son islet
cards.summary: Fish rafts, folk cakes, and garden fruit on an islet in the Hậu.

faqs.q: Is a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City enough?
faqs.a: It can reach the delta. It does not put you on the water for the wholesale boats. Be on the water by 5:00 or 5:30, leaving Ninh Kiều around 5:00. Sleep in Can Tho.

faqs.q: How far is Can Tho from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Vietnam Tourism gives about 165 km. The distance between the centres is 155 km. Thanh Niên and Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp Việt Nam give 120 km of expressway, about 2 hours or more than 2 hours, against about 3.5 hours before that corridor. The 120 km is the expressway length, not a third centre distance.
In the centre, within walk of Bến Ninh Kiều, so the dawn boat is honest. The evening is the quay. No bar street is the plan.

faqs.q: What does the Cái Răng boat cost?
faqs.a: The department listing marks the price đang cập nhật. The department advice page gives 300,000–700,000 VND a boat, depending on the number of guests. A ticket at the market is also đang cập nhật.

faqs.q: Can I take a train to Can Tho?
faqs.a: No passenger station is open. Do not plan a train that ends here. The Hanoi approach is 30 hours by train to Ho Chi Minh City, then a bus. A studied Ho Chi Minh City–Can Tho line is not a service.

Óoc Om Bóc and the Ngo boat race, Kỳ Yên Thượng Điền at Đình Bình Thủy, the river-culture festival, the southern folk-cake festival, and the city’s food week are on the department’s lists. Those lists do not give the next civil dates. Lễ Thượng Điền and Lễ Hạ Điền are named at Ninh Kiều and are not described as the same rite as the Bình Thủy Kỳ Yên.

season.label: Dry months, fruit, then the flood boat
season.note: A dry season runs from December to April, fruit in the gardens from June to August, and a flood season from September to November, which is when the boat to Cái Răng is the move. Flowers near Tết fall in December and January. The average is about 28°C, warm and humid all year. The market runs through the year.
